code:
import json, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap
g=json.load(open("plp_pocket_geometry.json")); acc=g["accsl_vs_plp"]; tom=g["tomato_vs_plp"]
ot=pd.read_csv("ortholog_catalytic_residue_table.csv").rename(columns={"Unnamed: 0":"tomato_ACS"})
gv=pd.read_csv("gnomad_ACCSL_variants.csv")

pair=[("Schiff base Lys","Lys395 NZ - PLP C4A","Lys278 NZ - PLP C4A"),
      ("Pyridine N1 Asp","Asp358 OD2 - PLP N1","Asp237 OD2 - PLP N1"),
      ("Phosphate Arg","Arg403 NH1 - PLP phosphate(min)","Arg286 - PLP phos(min)"),
      ("Phosphate Ser","Ser394 OG - PLP phosphate(min)","Ser277 OG - PLP phos(min)"),
      ("Asn (si face)","Asn330 ND2 - PLP(min)","Asn209 ND2 - PLP(min)"),
      ("Ring stack Tyr","Tyr361 ring centroid - PLP ring centroid","Tyr240 centroid - PLP centroid"),
      ("Phos-loop residue","Gly241 N - PLP phosphate(min)","Gly126 N - PLP phos(min)")]
lab=[p[0] for p in pair]; a=[acc[p[1]] for p in pair]; t=[tom[p[2]] for p in pair]

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3, figsize=(17,5.6))
ax=axes[0]; x=np.arange(len(lab)); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2,a,w,color="#2c6fbb",label="ACCSL AlphaFold model, transplanted PLP")
ax.bar(x+w/2,t,w,color="#9a9a9a",label="Tomato ACS 1IAX, crystallographic PLP")
for i,(va,vt) in enumerate(zip(a,t)):
    ax.text(i-w/2,va+0.08,f"{va:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
    ax.text(i+w/2,vt+0.08,f"{vt:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=7.5,color="#555555")
ax.axhline(3.5,ls="--",c="firebrick",lw=1)
ax.text(len(lab)-0.45,3.62,"3.5 A H-bond limit",color="firebrick",ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(lab,rotation=30,ha="right",fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_ylabel("Distance to PLP (A)"); ax.set_ylim(0,8.2)
ax.set_title("a  PLP half-site geometry is intact in ACCSL",fontsize=10); ax.legend(fontsize=8)

cols=["human ACCSL","mouse Accsl","rat Accsl","human ACCS","mouse Accs"]
rows=ot[~ot.tomato_ACS.str.contains("len|%id")].reset_index(drop=True)
three={"Leu":"L","Ala":"A","Asn":"N","Tyr":"Y","Arg":"R","Thr":"T","Asp":"D","Ile":"I","Ser":"S","Lys":"K","Gly":"G"}
status=np.zeros((len(rows),len(cols)))
for i,r in rows.iterrows():
    tok=r.tomato_ACS.split()[0]
    ref=three.get(tok[:3], tok[-1])
    for j,c in enumerate(cols):
        status[i,j]= 1 if str(r[c])[0]==ref else 0
ax=axes[1]
ax.imshow(status,cmap=ListedColormap(["#c0433a","#3f8f4f"]),aspect="auto",vmin=0,vmax=1)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(rows))); ax.set_yticklabels(rows.tomato_ACS,fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(cols))); ax.set_xticklabels(cols,rotation=30,ha="right",fontsize=8.5)
for i in range(len(rows)):
    for j,c in enumerate(cols):
        ax.text(j,i,str(rows.iloc[i][c]),ha="center",va="center",fontsize=6.5,color="white")
ax.set_title("b  Green: tomato ACS catalytic residue retained",fontsize=10)

ax=axes[2]
af=float(gv[gv.rsid=="rs2074051"].af.iloc[0])
bars=["Arg529\nmajor allele","Cys529\nRefSeq allele","Tyr423\nfixed","Phe272\nfixed"]
vals=[af,1-af,1.0,1.0]
ax.bar(bars,vals,color=["#3f8f4f","#c0433a","#c0433a","#c0433a"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+0.015,f"{v:.3f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(0,1.18); ax.set_ylabel("Frequency in humans (gnomAD v4.1)")
ax.set_title("c  Substrate-carboxylate residue 529 is polymorphic;\nthe two activity-limiting substitutions are fixed",fontsize=10)
ax.tick_params(axis="x",labelsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
json.dump({"panelA":{p[0]:[acc[p[1]],tom[p[2]]] for p in pair},"rs2074051_AF":af},
          open("final_figure_values.json","w"), indent=1)
print({p[0]:(acc[p[1]],tom[p[2]]) for p in pair})
